        while (true) {
            String newString = string.replaceFirst("dot", m -> {
                int start = m.start();
                if (start > 0 && start < string.length() - 3) {

            if (newString.equals(string)) {
                break;
            }
            string = newString;
        }

            int start = m.start();
            if (start > 0) {
                return "@";
            } else {
                return "at";
            }
        });

        System.out.println(string);
